nodes.name: Webhook — Campaign Status Changed
nodes.notes: Twenty sends POST when Campaign.status → pending_review. Payload: { campaign_id, request_id, event, object_metadata }

nodes.name: HTTP — GET Campaign from Twenty

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `query GetCampaign($id: ID!) { campaign(id: $id) { id name goal offer { markdown } persona status aiBudgetNok aiSpentNok startDate endDate reviewNotes } }`, variables: { id: $('Set — Extract & Propagate Context').item.json.campaign_id } }) }}

nodes.notes: GraphQL query against Twenty server. Returns campaign record including persona JSON and offer rich text.

nodes.name: Anthropic Haiku — Brand Voice Check
nodes.notes: Haiku: ~500 tok in + 256 tok out ≈ 0.19 NOK. Hard limit: max_tokens=1024.

nodes.name: Anthropic Sonnet — Ad Variant Gen
nodes.notes: Sonnet: ~1500 tok in + 1800 tok out ≈ 9.9 NOK. 9 variants × platforms.

nodes.name: Anthropic Sonnet — LP Config Gen
nodes.notes: Sonnet: ~1200 tok in + 800 tok out per variant ≈ 6 NOK. Runs per variant item.

nodes.name: HTTP — POST LP Config to control-api
nodes.notes: control-api saves config to Postgres (lp_pages) and returns { id, slug }.

nodes.name: HTTP — POST KV Sync Trigger
nodes.notes: Pushes LP config to Cloudflare KV. URL goes live immediately after this call.

nodes.name: HTTP — POST Postiz Schedule Ad

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ platform: $json.platform, headline: $json.headline, body: $json.body_copy, cta: $json.cta_label, destination_url: 'https://lp.' + ($json.lp_slug) + '.example.com/lp/' + $json.lp_slug, variant_tag: $json.variant_tag, campaign_id: $json.campaign_id, status: 'scheduled', metadata: { angle: $json.angle, lp_id: $json.lp_id, request_id: $json.request_id } }) }}

nodes.notes: Schedules ad creative in Postiz. Each variant gets its own post pointing to its dedicated LP URL.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation UpdateCampaignApproved($id: ID!, $reviewNotes: String) { updateCampaign(id: $id, data: { status: approved, reviewNotes: $reviewNotes }) { id status } }', variables: { id: $json.campaign_id, reviewNotes: `Auto-approved. ${$json.variant_count} variants generated for platforms: ${$json.platforms.join(', ')}. Slugs: ${$json.slugs.join(', ')}.` } }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP — PATCH Twenty Campaign → failed (no id)

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation UpdateCampaignFailed($id: ID!, $reason: String) { updateCampaign(id: $id, data: { status: failed, failureReason: $reason }) { id status } }', variables: { id: $('Set — Extract & Propagate Context').item.json.campaign_id ?? 'unknown', reason: 'Webhook payload missing campaign_id. Cannot process.' } }) }}

nodes.notes: Reached when campaign_id is absent from webhook payload.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation UpdateCampaignFailed($id: ID!, $reason: String) { updateCampaign(id: $id, data: { status: failed, failureReason: $reason }) { id status } }', variables: { id: $json.campaign_id, reason: `Brand check failed (score: ${$json.brand_score}/100). Flags: ${($json.brand_flags ?? []).join(', ')}. ${$json.brand_summary}` } }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP — PATCH Twenty Campaign → failed (exception)

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation UpdateCampaignFailed($id: ID!, $reason: String) { updateCampaign(id: $id, data: { status: failed, failureReason: $reason }) { id status } }', variables: { id: $json.execution?.customData?.campaign_id ?? 'unknown', reason: ('Workflow exception: ' + ($json.error?.message ?? 'unknown error') + ' in node: ' + ($json.error?.node?.name ?? 'unknown')) } }) }}

nodes.notes: Catches any unhandled exception across the whole workflow and marks campaign failed.
